post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Associate Professor in the subject for 3 years at a recognized medical institution; at least 2 research publications after becoming Associate Professor (among the first three authors); completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research; must undergo the Basic Course in Medical Education. A Senior Consultant with 3 years' experience as a postgraduate teacher of a broad/super specialty subject at an NBE-recognized government medical institute is also eligible.

Assistant Professor in the subject for 4 years at a recognized medical institution, or 5 years for those appointed directly as Assistant Professor in a government medical institution; at least 2 research publications after becoming Assistant Professor (among the first three authors); completed the Basic Course in Biomedical Research; must undergo the Basic Course in Medical Education. A non-teaching Consultant/Specialist/Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and 10 years' experience in at least a 220-bedded government hospital is also eligible, subject to completing both basic courses within two years of appointment.

One year as Senior Resident in the concerned subject at a recognized medical institution (Tutor or Demonstrator experience with the relevant PG qualification may count as equivalent); or a non-teaching Consultant/Specialist/Medical Officer with a PG medical degree and at least 2 years' experience in a government hospital with at least 220 beds; or diploma holders appointed as Senior Resident before 08-06-2017 with 4 years' total experience; or diploma holders working as Specialist/Medical Officer with 6 years' cumulative experience in a government medical institution.
Undergoing residency after obtaining a postgraduate degree (MD/MS/DNB), or a postgraduate MSc with PhD in Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, or Microbiology.

the duration of teaching experience in that cadre and total teaching experience will be considered. Selection is nationwide

with first preference given to local candidates for Assistant Professor-level posts; candidates from elsewhere will be considered if local candidates are not available. Professor and Associate Professor posts belong to the state cadre. DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest NMC guidelines. Rule of Reservation will be followed.
important_instructions: This is a temporary contract/honorarium appointment up to 31-03-2027, or till vacancies are filled by promotion/regular appointment, or till the need ceases, whichever is earlier; it does not confer any right to future government appointment. Non-local candidates must get their qualification registered with the Telangana State Medical Council within one week of selection, for their appointment to be confirmed. Selected faculty are eligible for 15 days of leave per calendar year, on a cumulative basis. The selected candidate must submit a relieving order from their previous institute, failing which the selection stands cancelled. Candidates already working on contract in the same cadre at any other Government Medical College in Telangana are not eligible to apply. The contract is liable to be terminated at any time without assigning any reason; the selected faculty may similarly terminate the contract with one month's prior notice. The engaged faculty will be under the administrative control of the institute on a whole-time basis, and services may be utilized in any manner required by the Competent Authority without additional remuneration claims. If a selected candidate does not join, the next eligible merit candidate will be selected.

content_sections.heading: GMC KB Asifabad Salary / Consolidated Pay
content_sections.text: Selected faculty will be paid a fixed consolidated monthly remuneration as per G.O. Rt. No. 1276, Finance (HRM.VII) Department, dated 16 July 2026. The remuneration is all-inclusive and subject to tax deduction at source and other statutory deductions.

content_sections.heading: GMC KB Asifabad Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates will be selected based on merit, duration of teaching experience, and interview. For Professor and Associate Professor posts, the duration of teaching experience in that cadre and total teaching experience will be considered. Selection is nationwide, with first preference given to local candidates for Assistant Professor-level posts; candidates from elsewhere will be considered if local candidates are not available. Professor and Associate Professor posts belong to the state cadre. DNB candidates will be selected as per the latest NMC guidelines. Rule of Reservation will be followed.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for GMC KB Asifabad Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Filled-in application form (downloaded from the college website) Aadhar Card and PAN Card Proof of Date of Birth (SSC certificate or Birth certificate) Study/Bonafide certificates, Class 1 to Class 7 MBBS and MD/MS/DNB Degree certificates MBBS Registration and additional PG qualification registration with Telangana State Medical Council (applications without this registration will be rejected; non-local candidates must complete registration within one week of selection) Experience certificates for all State Government hospital/institution/programme appointments on contract or outsourced basis Senior Resident experience certificate (for Assistant Professor applicants) Copies of publications with proof of indexation Recent passport-size colour photograph Community certificate issued by competent authority, and Physically Handicapped certificate, where applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Attend the GMC KB Asifabad Walk-In Interview
content_sections.text: Download the application form from the official website, www.gmckumurambheemasifabad.org. Fill the application form completely and attach one set of self-attested photocopies of all required documents. Report to the O/o Principal, Government Medical College, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, on 11-09-2026, between 11:00 AM and 3:00 PM. Carry all original certificates along with the filled application and photocopies; applications that are incomplete or missing necessary enclosures will be summarily rejected. Attend the interview; original certificates will be retained under the custody of the Director, GMC, Siddipet, at the time of joining. There is no online or postal application process for this recruitment - candidates must appear in person on the interview date.

faq.question: Q1. What is GMC KB Asifabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment by Government Medical College, Kumuram Bheem Asifabad, for 99 posts of Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor (contract basis) and Senior Resident (honorarium basis), under Notification No. 01/2026 dated 01-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in GMC KB Asifabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 99 vacancies: 15 Professor, 26 Associate Professor, 34 Assistant Professor, and 24 Senior Resident, spread across 19 departments.

faq.question: Q3. When is the GMC KB Asifabad walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 11-09-2026, from 11:00 AM to 3:00 PM, at the Office of the Principal, GMC Kumuram Bheem Asifabad.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for GMC KB Asifabad Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need MBBS with an MD/MS/DNB in the concerned subject and one year as Senior Resident in that subject at a recognized medical institution, along with registration with the Telangana State Medical Council (alternative routes for diploma holders and non-teaching specialists are also specified).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for GMC KB Asifabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates for Professor, Associate Professor, and Assistant Professor posts must be below 69 years as on 31-07-2026. Senior Resident candidates must be below 45 years (broad specialties) or below 50 years for Anatomy, Biochemistry, Physiology, Pharmacology, Microbiology, Pathology, Forensic Medicine, and Community Medicine.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for GMC KB Asifabad faculty posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly remuneration is ₹1,90,000 for Professor, ₹1,50,000 for Associate Professor, ₹1,25,000 for Assistant Professor, and ₹1,06,461 for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q7. Is the GMC KB Asifabad application process online or offline?
faq.answer: It is a walk-in interview. Candidates must bring the filled application form along with original certificates and photocopies to the interview venue on 11-09-2026; there is no online or postal submission.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for GMC KB Asifabad Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on merit, duration of teaching experience, and interview. For Professor and Associate Professor posts, teaching experience in that cadre and total teaching experience are specifically considered.
